analysis.title: AI panic on Wall Street (Nordic Alert)
key_insights: The S&P 500 fell 4.4% and the Nasdaq fell 5.5% on 11/5, the worst daily decline since 'Liberation Day' last year.

The selloff followed a relief rally on Wednesday driven by hopes that the Democrats' election victory would speed an end to the Iran war. On Thursday the market instead priced in concerns that the AI rollout will be halted because of broad Democratic resistance to building more data centers.
All AI-linked stocks fell, with chipmakers hit hardest: Nvidia -9%, Broadcom -10%, AMD more than -17%.
Anthropic is planning an IPO and the timing is described as hardly worse. SpaceX fell 9% and Tesla almost 11% as the Musk companies continued to suffer from the political hangover.
Asian markets kept falling on 11/6, with the Nikkei at -6% and the Kospi at -5%. Futures point to a calmer end to the week: Europe about 1% down and US futures slightly up.
FX markets were surprisingly calm given the equity moves, though the dollar strengthened against other currencies in a risk-off move.

US October payrolls are due 11/6. The market expects about +50k and an unemployment rate of 4.2%. September was weak and labor market signals are mixed. The outcome would be in line with the Fed's view.

Norges Bank held the policy rate at 4.50% on 11/5 as expected and repeated its guidance that the rate will likely need to stay elevated for a time and that it is prepared to raise further if the inflation outlook warrants. SEB still believes the policy rate has peaked, with risks skewed to the upside.
Swedish house prices in October (Mäklarstatistik): tenant-owned apartments +1.9% m/m (+5.8% y/y), detached houses -0.6% m/m (-4.2% y/y).

Over half a million people took part in a general strike in France on 11/5 over study conditions, wages and welfare. SEB notes it will be difficult to reconcile those demands with the fiscal situation.

market_movers.rationale: Nvidia closed down 9% on 11/5 as AI and data center concerns hit chipmakers hardest.
Broadcom closed down 10% on 11/5 in the AI-linked selloff.
AMD fell more than 17% on 11/5, the largest drop among the chipmakers cited.
Tesla fell almost 11% on 11/5 as the Musk companies continued to suffer from the political hangover.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Market expectation for the 11/6 release. Last month was weak. SEB says this outcome would be well in line with the Fed's view.
Held as widely expected. Guidance says the rate will likely need to stay elevated for a time, with readiness to hike if inflation warrants. SEB thinks the rate has peaked.

risk_factors: The AI rollout may be halted because of broad Democratic resistance to new data centers.
The Anthropic IPO timing is weakened by the AI selloff.
The French fiscal situation conflicts with the demands of the strikers.
Norges Bank risks are skewed to the upside for rates.
vol_and_positioning: Risk-off positioning: the dollar strengthened against other currencies, but FX markets were calm relative to equities.
geopolitical: Hopes that the Democrats' election victory will lead to a quick end to the Iran war drove a relief rally on Wednesday.
Over half a million people took part in a French general strike on 11/5.
Swedish Democrats leader Jimmie Åkesson holds a press conference in Sölvesborg at lunchtime on 11/6 on the government issue.
